# Cohesion walk walk-07: 40 item-on-target pairs, each on its own spot, real input only.
# Generated by tools/cohesion/gen_walk.py from tools/cohesion/pairs.tsv and setup.json; do not edit by hand.
# Run: bash tools/smoke.sh tools/cohesion/walk-07.txt   then: python tools/cohesion/collect.py run-smoke/smoke-out OUTDIR
@world flat
@gamemode survival
@difficulty easy
@observe 30
wait 40
/gamerule doMobSpawning false
/gamerule doDaylightCycle false
/gamerule doWeatherCycle false
/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
/gamerule keepInventory true
/gamerule showDeathMessages false
/gamerule spawnRadius 0
/gamerule announceAdvancements false
/time set 6000
/weather clear
/setworldspawn 0 -60 -130
/forceload add -96 -112 96 112
wait 40
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player]
wait 5
report WALK walk-07 40 pairs

# ---- P245: headinajar:syringe | BODY | host (sawn pig)
report PAIR P245 begin spot -72 -96 expect BODY aim entity | headinajar:syringe | BODY | host (sawn pig)
/say PAIR P245
/kill @e[type=minecraft:slime]
/tp @s -71.5 -60 -95.5 0 0
/effect give @s minecraft:resistance 999 4 true
/effect give @s minecraft:saturation 999 0 true
wait 5
hostify minecraft:pig -72 -60 -94
wait 5
/data merge entity @e[type=minecraft:pig,x=-71.5,y=-60,z=-93.5,distance=..1.5,limit=1] {NoAI:1b}
/clear @s
wait 5
/tp @s -71.5 -60 -95.5 0 30.3
wait 3
lookpos -71.5 -59.55 -93.5
wait 10
/item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with headinajar:syringe
/item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with minecraft:air
wait 10
riding PRE-P245
inspect me
inspect aim
report PAIR P245 act key use
key use
wait 12
shot cw-P245
wait 17
inspect me
report PAIR P245 end
/kill @s
wait 15
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player,x=-78,y=-62,z=-102,dx=18,dy=14,dz=18]
/fill -78 -60 -102 -60 -48 -84 minecraft:air
/fill -78 -61 -102 -60 -61 -84 minecraft:grass_block
wait 3
/kill @e[type=minecraft:item,x=-78,y=-62,z=-102,dx=18,dy=14,dz=18]
